message: Hi, my little one Hana is 5 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! Our Little Warriors program is perfect for 5-year-olds.
It's no-gi jiu jitsu for ages 4-6, and classes are Wednesday and Thursday from 4:45-5:30 pm. Would Hana like to try a free trial class?
Yes, she'd love to try a free trial class! Let's go with the first available time. What do I need to do next?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the trial details to tester.anchor@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Hana's full name and date of birth to get her trial booked.
Hana's full name is Hana Anchor, and her birthday is February 28, 2021.

Perfect! I have Hana all set. The earliest available times are:

Wednesday, July 15 at 4:45 pm
Thursday, July 16 at 4:45 pm

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 15 at 4:45 pm. Thank you!

All set! Hana is booked for her free trial on Wednesday, July 15 at 4:45 pm. We'll send the details to tester.anchor@gmail.com. Just bring Hana in comfortable clothes and we'll take care of the rest. See you both soon!
